Hey guys! I absolutely love both of these songs, and thought they go beautifully together. I'm always in awe when I hear Saili sing and have been wanting to collaborate with her for so long. She's also my Hindustani music teacher - I'm beyond honored that she is part of this video and singing with me. Saili is the bomb, show her some love!
Thank you to fam Shankar Tucker for music and video production. And Jomy George for KILLIN' it on tabla. Love you both!
